subject: reindeer
title: In Winter, a Reindeer's Eyes Turn From Gold to Blue

scenes.text: In winter, a reindeer's eyes turn from gold to deep blue.
Scientists at University College London showed it was the first colour change of its kind seen in a mammal.
Behind the retina sits a mirror layer. Pressure in the eye changes it, and the colour shifts.
Arctic winter light is blue twilight, so the eye shifts to catch exactly that.
Reported results say the winter eye is up to 1,000 times more light-sensitive, though the picture gets blurrier.
Gold for the summer sun. Blue for the winter dark.

description:
In winter, a reindeer's eyes turn from gold to deep blue.
A mirror layer behind the retina changes with pressure, making the eye far more sensitive in the dim blue light of the Arctic.
